lines.A01: This is CosyLift. Let's take a closer look.
lines.A02: Only three centimetres flat – it disappears under your mattress.
lines.A03: The backrest folds up along this hinge – smoothly, to any position.
lines.A04: The motor moves you into position – whisper-quiet.
lines.A05: Small, but a real powerhouse: it carries up to 150 kilograms.
lines.A06: One press on the remote, and you sit up – up to 59 degrees.
lines.A07: It fits mattresses from 80 to 120 centimetres – on a slatted frame, a box spring, even on the floor.
lines.A08: Read, work or relax – sitting up comfortably in your own bed.
lines.A09: CosyLift. Make more of your bed.
